name: MonarchBadge
title: Badge
summary: A short status or metadata label in five tones and three variants.
whenToUse: For the status of an item in a list, a table or a card.
whenNotToUse: For a message about a screen or a section use MonarchBanner. For the notification dot on a navigation item use the Material 3 Badge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBadge(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, variant: MonarchBadgeVariant = MonarchBadgeVariant.Subtle, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchBadgeVariant { Subtle, Solid, Outline }

options.name: text
options.description: The label; one or two words.

options.name: tone
options.description: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger.

states.name: default
states.description: Not interactive; one look per tone and variant.

appearance: Subtle is a tinted fill with strong text, solid a strong fill with the text color made for it, outline a border with strong text. Each pair comes from one tone family, in every theme.
platformNotes: The web also has an accent tone, an accent tone; it is not offered. A sm size and a dot are offered. The badge is at least 24dp high, against 22px on the web, and grows with the font size setting.
accessibility: Read as text; the tone is never the only carrier of meaning.
Not interactive, so it has no touch target.
Grows with the font size setting.
edgeCases: Long text wraps inside the pill; keep it short.
An icon passed as leadingIcon takes the content color of the badge.
